data.name: Harisha
data.long_meaning: Harisha is a name derived from Sanskrit language, meaning 'God's Hara (protector) + Isha (lord)'. This name is often associated with the Hindu deity Hara, who is considered the protector and god of fertility, health, and wealth. The name Harisha represents power, protection, and lordship.

data.cultural_impact: Harisha is a popular Hindu name, particularly common in South India. In addition to its association with the deity Hara, Harisha is also believed to be a name of Lord Vishnu in some Puranic texts. The name reflects the faith and devotion of Hindu parents towards their deities, as they seek divine blessings for their child.

The name Harisha also implies a deep connection with the divine, symbolizing a strong spiritual bond and faith.
